title: State of MP through CBI v. Vyapam Examination & Recruitment Scam
crime_type: Organized Competitive Exam Fraud / Proxy Impersonation / OMR Engine Manipulation
court_or_authority: Supreme Court of India / Special CBI Sessions Court Gwalior & Bhopal
source: Supreme Court of India Judgment & Indian Kanoon
ipc_sections: Section 468 IPC (Forgery for purpose of cheating)
location: Bhopal, Gwalior & Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
evidence: Hard disk forensic extraction from Vyapam computer servers revealing altered excel sheets matching roll numbers to corrupt official codes
Photographs of proxy impersonators (scorers) from Uttar Pradesh and Bihar pasted over genuine admit cards
Seizure of ₹3 crore in cash and luxury vehicles from mastermind Indore residence
Testimonies of medical students admitting payment of ₹25 to 50 lakh for guaranteed entrance selection
modus_operandi: Systemic collusion between state exam board officials, middleman doctors, and high-scoring medical students. Arranged brilliant medical students to sit as proxy examinees (scorers) using manipulated admit card photos, or orchestrated engine-seat pairing where corrupt candidates sat adjacent to paid proxies. Alternatively left OMR answer sheets blank during exam to be filled post-submission in the board vault.
personality_disorder: Institutional parasitic corruption, normalization of illicit patronage, and high-stakes greed.
common_traits: Internal tampering of examination board database and seating engines
Blank OMR answer sheet submission and vault re-marking
Massive network of middleman doctors and bureaucrat brokers
summary: The largest educational recruitment fraud in Indian history, involving thousands of arrests and medical seat cancellations. Supreme Court transferred the probe to the CBI and established national computerized online examination norms (NEET) to eliminate state-level manipulation.
